ad_info.reference_style: Clean two-column benefits ad: a large product standing in front of a tall brand-colored arch on the left and a vertical stack of icon-tile-plus-text benefits on the right, under a centered headline
ad_info.angle_used: Beneficio sin sacrificio: curves without needles or surgery

global_identity.color_palette: Primary: hot fuchsia #E6177F and deep magenta #B0105E. Secondary: bottle black #0E0E10, bubblegum pink #FF8CC0, pale blush pink #FBE3EE, white #FFFFFF, and aguaje orange #D9572B only for fruit accents.
global_identity.visual_style: Premium Latin American beauty-supplement ad: clean pink and blush backgrounds, ultra-photorealistic Colombian women photographed naturally and respectfully, the black-and-fuchsia bottle as hero, clean icon modules.
global_identity.visual_atmosphere: Feminine, confident, warm and aspirational; soft daylight, believable real-life moments.
global_identity.graphic_language: Rounded pills and banners in fuchsia and deep magenta, thin-line white icons inside fuchsia circles, handwritten script accents used sparingly, clean flat or softly graded backgrounds with minimal decoration (no clutter, no excess particles, petals or sparkles).
global_identity.text_typography: Poppins Bold (uppercase, heavy) for headlines and labels, Poppins Regular for supporting text, and a casual handwritten script for short emotional accents.

creative_objective: State the core desire directly: curves on her own terms, without needles or surgery. The bottle is the hero inside a fuchsia arch, and four short benefits prove the promise at a glance, keeping the clean F08 two-column structure.

art_direction.design_quality: Premium, polished, modern, scroll-stopping, professionally designed, commercially strong
art_direction.visual_hierarchy: 1) The headline at the top. 2) The black-and-fuchsia bottle framed by the fuchsia arch on the left. 3) The four benefit rows on the right, read top to bottom, with the fuchsia icon tiles as anchors.
art_direction.composition_style: Asymmetric two-column grid under a centered full-width headline. Left column (6-50% of width): tall arch panel with the bottle standing in front. Right column (54-94% of width): four benefit rows. Both columns share the same vertical band below the headline.
art_direction.spacing_and_structure: Headline 6-21% of the height, centered, up to 88% of the width. Arch from about 10% to 46% of the width and 28% to 94% of the height, fully rounded top. Bottle centered on the arch, base at about 90% of the height, about 52% of the canvas height. Four benefit rows evenly spaced between 28% and 92% of the height, icon tile on the left of each row and text to its right.
art_direction.lighting_and_depth: Soft studio light from the upper left; soft contact shadow under the bottle at the base of the arch; the arch has a very subtle vertical gradient and a faint soft shadow. Icon tiles and text are flat for maximum legibility.
art_direction.conversion_feel: The ad must feel persuasive, eye-catching, emotionally engaging, credible, elegant and commercially strong

reference_structure_analysis.layout_summary: Square canvas with a soft gradient from pale blush pink (#FBE3EE) at the top to bubblegum pink (#FF8CC0) at the bottom. A bold centered two-line headline spans the top. Below, in the left half, a tall arch-shaped panel (rectangle with a fully rounded top) in hot fuchsia #E6177F with the product bottle standing large in front of it. In the right half, four benefit rows stacked with equal spacing; each row has a solid deep magenta rounded-square tile with a simple white line icon, followed by a short bold benefit text in bottle black. No other elements.

detected_visual_blocks.visual_function: Calm brand-colored base that keeps the layout clean and scannable
detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: Smooth soft gradient from pale blush pink #FBE3EE (top) to light bubblegum pink #FF8CC0 (bottom). No patterns, no textures, no particles.

detected_visual_blocks.position: Top center, 6-21% of the canvas height, up to 88% of the width
detected_visual_blocks.visual_function: States the main promise: curves without needles or surgery
detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: Two lines, extra bold uppercase; 'SIN AGUJAS NI QUIRÓFANO' in hot fuchsia, the rest in bottle black.

detected_visual_blocks.position: Left column, from about 10% to 46% of the canvas width and from about 28% to 94% of the height, fully rounded top
detected_visual_blocks.visual_function: Frames the bottle like a showcase niche
detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: Solid hot fuchsia #E6177F arch with a very subtle vertical gradient toward deep magenta #B0105E at the bottom and a faint soft shadow. Flat graphic shape, no texture, no text.

detected_visual_blocks.position: In front of the arch, centered on it, base at about 90% of the canvas height, about 50-56% of the canvas height
detected_visual_blocks.visual_function: Main visual anchor; shows what delivers the benefits
detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: The user's bottle exactly as in the attached photo, front or slight 3/4 view, upright, label facing the camera, soft contact shadow, with a visible band of fuchsia arch around it.

detected_visual_blocks.position: Right column, at the left edge of each benefit row (starting at about 54% of the width)
detected_visual_blocks.visual_function: Visual anchors that make each benefit scannable
detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: Solid deep magenta #B0105E rounded-square tiles, about 9% of the canvas per side, each with one simple white monoline icon: 1) a heart, 2) a lightning bolt, 3) a capsule, 4) a leaf. Same style, stroke and size. No body or silhouette icons.

detected_visual_blocks.position: Right column, to the right of each icon tile (about 66-94% of the width), vertically centered on it
detected_visual_blocks.visual_function: Names each benefit in a few words
detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: One short benefit per row in bold bottle black, max 2 lines each.

forbidden_additions: Price, discount, offer or urgency badge
Trust seals, guarantee or certification badges
Callout lines or arrows pointing at the product
Numbers or numbering on the benefit rows
Divider lines, boxes or cards behind each benefit
Round pedestal or circular backdrop shape
Logos or brand marks other than those printed on the product label
Fruits, leaves, petals, sparkles or particles

visual_prompt: Square 1:1 premium supplement ad with a clean two-column layout. Background: smooth soft gradient from pale blush pink #FBE3EE at the top to light bubblegum pink #FF8CC0 at the bottom, no texture, no decoration. Top center, from about 6% to 21% of the canvas height and up to 88% of the width: a bold centered two-line headline in heavy uppercase Poppins Bold; first line in bottle black #0E0E10, second line in hot fuchsia #E6177F. Below the headline, left column: a tall arch-shaped panel (rectangle with a fully rounded top) in hot fuchsia #E6177F with a very subtle gradient to deep magenta #B0105E at its base and a faint soft shadow, spanning about 10% to 46% of the canvas width and 28% to 94% of the height. Standing in front of the arch, centered on it, with its base at about 90% of the canvas height and about 52% of the canvas height tall: the product bottle, which must be reproduced exactly from the attached product image (the only source of truth; do not redesign, replace or reinterpret it): a matte black cylindrical plastic supplement bottle, about 1.6 times taller than wide, with a glossy hot-pink/magenta screw cap printed with a repeating small white 'VITALABH' wordmark pattern, and a solid hot-pink band wrapping the bottom fifth of the bottle. The black label shows, from top to bottom: a small pink VITALABH emblem with the white word 'VITALABH'; a huge bold white condensed word 'AGUAJE'; the line 'COMPLEX 3 EN 1' with 'COMPLEX' in white and '3 EN 1' in pink-red; a thin hot-pink banner reading 'SUPLEMENTO ALIMENTICIO EN CÁPSULAS'; a small white line 'A base de Aguaje, Fenogreco y Maca Negra'; a bold italic hot-pink 'TRIPLE ACCIÓN' with a pink swoosh underline; three small black rounded boxes outlined in pink joined by white plus signs reading '200mg AGUAJE', '400mg FENOGRECO' and '200mg MACA NEGRA'; and at the bottom '60 CÁPSULAS | (0.5 g c/u Cont. Neto 30g)' in small white type. Front or slight 3/4 view, label facing the camera, soft studio key light from the upper left, soft contact shadow at the base. Right column, from about 54% to 94% of the width: four benefit rows evenly spaced between about 28% and 92% of the canvas height; each row starts with a solid deep magenta #B0105E rounded-square tile (about 9% of the canvas per side, corner radius about 30%) holding a simple white monoline icon (row 1 a heart, row 2 a lightning bolt, row 3 a capsule, row 4 a leaf), followed by a short bold benefit text in bottle black, left-aligned, max 2 lines. Flat icons and text, no shadows. Generous clean spacing, nothing touching the edges. No people, no body silhouettes, no extra graphics, no CTA, no price, no badges, no stars.
